spots.name: Annecy - Planfait
spots.takeoff_description: during summer holidays, the site/ launch can be very busy.
spots.going_there: by car/ hiking; during the summer a shuttle bus is available
spots.weather_notes:
wx links:
- http://www.chamoisvolants.fr/liens-meteo/
- http://www.lespassagersduvent.com/meteo/
spots.transport_notes: Bus depuis Annecy vers Talloires puis montée à Planfait.
spots.fr_notes: Planfait, au-dessus du lac d'Annecy. Site école majeur, décollage Ouest, atterrissage officiel à Doussard/Perroix selon consigne. Très fréquenté l'été.

spots.name: Challes-les-Eaux — Mont Saint-Michel
spots.takeoff_description: Décollage du Mont Saint-Michel, large pente herbeuse face Ouest/Nord-Ouest dominant Challes-les-Eaux.
spots.going_there: Depuis Challes-les-Eaux, route de la Thuile puis Curienne ; navettes des écoles locales. Gare SNCF Chambéry–Challes-les-Eaux à proximité de l'atterrissage.
spots.weather_notes: Brise de vallée bien établie l'après-midi. Éviter par vent d'Est (vent de cul au décollage et rotors sous le vent du relief).
spots.comments: Site historique du vol libre savoyard, berceau d'écoles de parapente. Coordonnées indicatives — se référer au balisage local.
spots.flight_rules: Proximité de l'aérodrome de Challes-les-Eaux : respecter les consignes locales et les axes de la piste planeurs.

landing.name: Atterrissage officiel de Challes-les-Eaux
landing.description: Grand terrain près de l'aérodrome, balisé par les écoles.

spots.transport_notes: Gare SNCF Chambéry–Challes-les-Eaux proche de l'atterrissage ; navettes écoles pour remonter au décollage.
spots.fr_notes: Le site école emblématique de Chambéry. Décollage Ouest/Nord-Ouest au Mont Saint-Michel, atterrissage vaste près de l'aérodrome. Aérologie douce le matin et en fin de journée, thermique actif en mi-journée.

spots.name: Chamrousse - l'Aiguille / la Croix
spots.takeoff_description:
> l'Aiguille: alti: 1840m; on a little hill, just above 'Recoin' village.
> 'la Sapiniere' lies a little lower/ to the NW and is used if 'Aiguille' is in clouds.
> la Croix: alti: 2250m; near the cable car, on the sky station summit. good grass shield.
3 take off, 2 landings, 600 m to 1800 m flying .
spots.weather_notes:
be careful of strong wind, especially NE and SW.
http://www.balisemeteo.com/balise.php?idBalise=144
spots.comments:
XC: la Croix is often easier to XC start than l'aiguille take-off, especially when inversion is high. Might be big XC start to the East, but it's tough, narrow valleys with wind.
it's THE site when you finish your job, at the end of the day. You can make beautifull cross-country in 'Belledonne' mountain, in the north.
It's often possible to hitch a ride from the LZ
spots.flight_rules:
Specific National Park regulations in les Ecrins, starting 15 km SE
Overlying the zone between the cablecar/ Chairlift below 300m/ agl NOT allowed!
spots.transport_notes: Bus depuis Grenoble en saison, route de Chamrousse.
spots.fr_notes: Décollage de l'Aiguille / la Croix à Chamrousse. Face Ouest, vols plaine-montagne au-dessus d'Uriage. Brise de vallée bien établie l'après-midi.

spots.name: Croix de Chamrousse
spots.transport_notes: Bus Transisère T87/express depuis Grenoble jusqu'à Chamrousse en saison. Télécabine possible l'hiver.
spots.fr_notes: Grand décollage à la Croix de Chamrousse (2219 m), face Ouest sur la vallée de Grenoble. Gros dénivelé, vols du soir magiques. Thermiques forts en été à la mi-journée — à réserver aux pilotes autonomes dans ces créneaux. Atterrissage officiel à Vaulnaveys / Uriage selon consigne club.

spots.name: L'épine - lac d'aiguebelette
spots.takeoff_description:
alti:1150m
after 13h the breeze is coming. Thermic during the afternoon, great flight at the end of the day, over the Aiguebelette lake.
spots.going_there:
from Chambéry take the highway to Lyon. After the 'L'Épine' tunnel go out (Novalaise/Lac d'Aiguebelette, exit n°12). First crossroad on your left, and another time left immediately. Landing is just behind trees.
To go on the takeoff go to the 'col de l'Épine' pass with the D916 road. Just before the pass turn on your left and take a road on 3 km. Follow 'décollage' advertising.
spots.weather_notes:
The takeoff is under the wind if it's coming from the North, NE, E or SE.
Still flyable and possible to takeoff by North moderate wind (bellow 15km/h) but be careful by higher wind.
By any East component of wind you might find a gentle West breeze at takeoff to let you believe it is fine. Be extra careful, check the wind sock on tree top. You might be able to take off anyway but your flight might be rough and very uncomfortable (even dangerous).
spots.comments: good for child, there is a beautiful lake just near the site. No wind and hot water.
spots.transport_notes: Route du col de l'Épine depuis Novalaise ou Chambéry.
spots.fr_notes: L'Épine, face Est au-dessus du lac d'Aiguebelette. Beau site de soaring et de thermique, cadre magnifique sur le lac.

spots.name: La Dent de Crolles
spots.takeoff_description: From the 'Col du Coq' pass take the path to the 'Dent de Crolles' summit. It watch you all the time during your walking up.
spots.going_there: Like Saint hilaire site, but go to 'col du Coq' pass with your car and park it. If you want big walking, park your car near the Syndicat landing, Saint hilaire village. If you want more ( around 1700m walking up!) park your car in lumbin village.
spots.transport_notes: Col du Coq en voiture puis ~1h de marche.
spots.fr_notes: La Dent de Crolles (2050 m), décollage en altitude après marche d'approche. Vol montagne engagé, réservé aux pilotes autonomes : aérologie de crête, pas de dégagement proche.

spots.name: Le chat
spots.transport_notes: Route du Col du Chat puis piste vers le relais du Mont du Chat.
spots.fr_notes: Le Mont du Chat, au-dessus du lac du Bourget. Décollage Est, gros potentiel de vol de distance le long de l'Épine. Restitution au-dessus du lac le soir. Aérologie exigeante par vent d'ouest (rotors sous le vent de la crête).

spots.name: Le Grand Ratz
spots.takeoff_description:
20 mn by foot from parking at Le Grand Ratz village,
over La Placette pass,
near Pommiers La Placette,
north of Voreppe,
15 km NW of Grenoble

Afternoon and evening take off.

Caution with south wind, not detectable at take off ...
spots.going_there:
see map and directions on website :
http://federation.ffvl.fr/structure/310/sites/38016
spots.weather_notes: South wind may be undetectable at take off, and become very strong at landing. You will also fly in dangerous conditions (downwind rotors)
spots.fr_notes: Le Grand Ratz, entre Voreppe et Voiron. Décollage Sud-Est dominant la cluse de Voreppe. Bon site de thermique de proximité pour le bassin voironnais.

spots.name: Montlambert
spots.takeoff_description:
alti: 890m
after 12h thermals and breeze can be strong.
Lot's of pilots come here, we thank you to drive slowly and respect the people living on the road to the launch area. This site is fragile! If people complain too much we might lose the right to fly here.
So don't unload your car at the turning point on top. Do it when parked further down the road. Respect nature, the people and regulations!
spots.going_there:
Landing area: from Montmelian, take the N6 road. Turn to the left to 'Saint Jean de la Porte'. Before 'St Jean' turn to the left just after passing a bridge and go along a canal during 1 km. You have to cross a small bridge again.
Take off from landing area: at the end of the dirt road turn left. In 'Saint Jean de la Porte' turn left. After 1 or 2 km turn to the right, to Montlambert. In Montlambert turn back and and park your car, but not in the village! Walk 10 mn to the Southwest.
spots.weather_notes:
With North wind : The only site (with Courtet) where you can fly around Grenoble. But be careful with strong North wind (above ~20km/h) it's just a little protection and the wind can come quite suddenly. Also be careful when flying over ~1400m, the upper mountain protection can stop and you can find turbulences due to being on the lee side.
With SW wind or W wind, the take off is on the lee side of the takeoff's West side crest, if wind speed is low (below 10km/h) it might still be okay but not by stronger SW or W wind.
With W wind it's flyable, but it might be uncomfortable because of turbulences far above the valley.
In doubt, meet pilots on the site for advices.
spots.comments: This site is closed between mid September to beginning of November, because of an agreement with the local hunters. It is their best moment of joy, so again respect their fun as they do ours! Please inform yourselves about exact days of no-flying. On some days flying is still allowed.
spots.transport_notes: Route depuis Saint-Jeoire-Prieuré / Montlambert, 20 min de Chambéry.
spots.fr_notes: Montlambert, face Ouest au-dessus de la combe de Chambéry. Site école et de soaring très utilisé par les clubs chambériens, vols du soir réputés.

spots.name: Montmin (Col de la Forclaz)
spots.takeoff_description:
Alti: 1240m
from Annecy go to 'col de la forclaz'. here take the road to the north and park your car after a few meters. Walk 10 mn.
spots.going_there: easy :-)
spots.weather_notes:
With NE wind it's unconfortable.
If nobody fly here, you can ask yourself why. It's the busiest site in France, with St Hilaire du Touvet.
spots.comments: good start for XC. You can see some flights with google earth to understand which flights you can have. look at 'view some gpd tracks of flights'.
spots.transport_notes: Col de la Forclaz par Montmin, navettes écoles depuis Doussard.
spots.fr_notes: La Forclaz de Montmin, le grand classique du lac d'Annecy. Décollage Ouest/Nord-Ouest face au lac, restitution du soir exceptionnelle, atterrissage à Doussard. Très fréquenté.

spots.name: Prapoutel les 7 laux
spots.comments: nobody use this site, exepted professional tandems during winter (skiing season...).
spots.fr_notes: Prapoutel — Les 7 Laux (1970 m), décollage Ouest sur le Grésivaudan. Gros dénivelé, thermiques dynamiques l'été, très beaux vols au couchant.

spots.name: Revard
spots.takeoff_description: Not very wide, but because it's a hanggliding site also, it is quite long ;-)
spots.going_there: Search for 'le restaurant du revard' on top of the mountain, the take off is 200m from here direction North
spots.weather_notes:
By strong North wind, going to the south just a bit might put you in impossibility to come back, even to the official landing.
Better stay North from take off.
Webcam: https://www.skaping.com/grandlac/revard
spots.comments: Nice XC site, from begginers to advance pilots
spots.transport_notes: Route du Revard depuis Aix-les-Bains, bus saisonnier. Gare SNCF à Aix-les-Bains (13 km de l'atterrissage).
spots.fr_notes: Le Revard, balcon du lac du Bourget (1515 m). Décollage Ouest face au lac, site école très apprécié, vols du soir en restitution exceptionnels. Attention au vent d'ouest fort qui crée du dégueulant derrière le plateau et à l'aérologie au-dessus du lac.

spots.name: Saint Hilaire du Touvet
spots.takeoff_description:
North take off is a comfortable big carpet, but may be downwind of the thermic blowing in front.
South take off's in grass and you may find more facing thermal wind here than in north take off.
spots.going_there:
Take off is just near the funicular station in Saint Hilaire village. If you come from Grenoble, cross 'St Nazaire' and go to 'St Pancrasse'. Cross 'St Pancrasse' and turn to the right in St Hilaire village, after the fireman house. The takeoff is under a big chalet. The south takeoff : don't turn after fireman house but park your car on the parking, on your right after 100m. Walk on the track (5mn), take off is on your right.
Bus from/to Grenoble (sorry only in french) : http://chvd.org/spip.php?article63
It may be a wise idea to leave the car at the landing site and go up by the funicular. Timetables and prices: http://www.funiculaire.fr/
spots.weather_notes:
be careful with South wind.
In spring, conditions can be quite hard, specialy near the cliff.
spots.comments:
an easy XC:
after take off go to the south (your right). Follow the cliff and cross the 'Manival', a little valley. Work the first thermal and go up to the crest of 'Saint Eynard'. Follow this crest to the south until a beautifull old 'fort'. Come back with the same way. After 'Manival' valley you can go up the the 'Dent de Crolles' summit and follow the big crest to 'Le Granier' summit in the north direction. Come back at 'St hilaire' and land near your car :-))
spots.flight_rules:
You must not climb over 3000m.
This flight regulation is due to the Lyon International Airport proximity. Please don't mess with it !
spots.transport_notes: Bus depuis Grenoble jusqu'à Lumbin (atterrissage), puis funiculaire de Montfort ou navette école jusqu'au plateau. Parking au décollage.
spots.fr_notes: LE site mythique de la région (Coupe Icare). Deux décollages face Est dominant la vallée du Grésivaudan, immense atterrissage officiel à Lumbin. Écoles sur place, très fréquenté. Conditions généralement douces le matin, thermiques puissants l'été en mi-journée. Attention à la sur-fréquentation et aux confluences en fin d'après-midi.

spots.name: Saint Pierre de Chartreuse - La Scia
spots.takeoff_description:
Two available : West & South
West take off should be avoided when ski resort is open.
Accessible by road then path, or cable car during winter and july-august.
No difficulty, large take off.
spots.going_there:
look at map and directions on website:
http://aec.apinc.org/article.php3?id_article=80
spots.weather_notes:
Take care with south wind that generally become strong in the afternoon.
Take off with north wind sometimes a bit hazardous.
spots.transport_notes: Télécabine de la Scia l'hiver et en été (juillet-août), sinon marche depuis Saint-Pierre-de-Chartreuse.
spots.fr_notes: La Scia, au cœur de la Chartreuse. Décollages Ouest et Sud, beau vol au-dessus de Saint-Pierre-de-Chartreuse.

spots.name: Verel pragondran
spots.takeoff_description: Verel Pragondran, cliff take off, be carefull by strong north wind. The begining of fantastic flights.
spots.going_there:
From Chambéry, go to 'Chambéry le haut', then Sonnaz, then 'col de Saint Saturnin', then go to left for 500m then right, then left.
Keep going until you reach the end of the road, a parking is here to avoid nuisance in the pragondran village.

Enter the village by foot, then a trail is indicated to your left, keep walking for 15 minutes, there you are.
spots.weather_notes:
Take off impossible by south wind unless very low wind and very strong thermals.

By North-East or East wind, generally flyable, because protected by the upper cliff, but above 1300m flying conditions might become a bit Rock & Roll
spots.comments:
NO FLIGHTS IN VALLEY !
Due to the airport, stay on the cliff from take off to landing at a 1000m maximum altitude.

Over the landing, you should be at a maximum of 50m height to ground (or 350m ASL)
spots.transport_notes: Route depuis Chambéry (15 min) jusqu'à Verel-Pragondran, courte marche.
spots.fr_notes: Site école du Nivolet, au-dessus de Chambéry. Décollage Sud-Ouest, aérologie douce le matin et en soldeur. Le site de proximité des Chambériens.

spots.name: Allevard-les Plagnes
spots.takeoff_description: on the top of the ski station. go by car to 'super-collet' and take the chair lift (open in winter and July-august). takeoff on the grass, near the ski tow.
spots.going_there: Go to Allevard. In Allevard go to the ski station 'le Collet d'Allevard'.
spots.weather_notes:
Don't go down in the little valley under the takeoff (veyton valley), you will have big difficult to go out. No landing :-)
If you land at the dike, be careful: it's forbiden and dangerous to fly over the lake. The breeze could be strong near the ground and you will land in the water...
spots.comments: verry good site with south wind in winter: a lot's of time in soaring! But be careful in the valley, the wind could be stronger.

spots.name: Allevard-Malatrait
spots.takeoff_description:
short takeoff. Little valley on your left very dangerous with north wind. On your front and right it's all good!
alti: 1450m
spots.going_there: from 'Allevard', go to 'le Collet d'Allevard', ski station. THe takeoff is on the road's border.
spots.weather_notes:
in the end of the day very good and mystic restitution on the middle valley. Landing with the night, take your light ;-)
Only when it's north wind and sunny during the day.
spots.comments: the landing area is a little bit technic. Ask to local pilots or to the school. In the school Pierrot is like a bear, but he never bite! :-)

spots.name: Allevard-south takeoff
spots.takeoff_description: Allevard South
spots.going_there: just near 'malatrait' takeoff. When you enter in the ski station (le Collet d'Allevard) take the road on your right, just after a white bilding. follow the road as far as the end.
spots.weather_notes: be careful of the gradient in 'la Mirande'. Sometime it's south wind on the takeoff but breeze direction on the landing area...
spots.comments:
The takeoff is rather small (only one by one) but you can prepare your wings at the rear.

If you land at the dyke, be careful: it's forbidden and dangerous to fly over the lake. The wind valley could be strong near the ground and you will land in the water...

spots.name: Allevard-St Pierre
spots.takeoff_description:
coming from the south (grenoble), take on the left when you enter in "St Pierre d'Allevard" village, direction "la Chapelle St Christophe". Walk 5 minuts.
alti: 1000m
spots.going_there: in Allevard valley.
spots.weather_notes: you are under the wind when it\'s north or NW wind.
spots.comments: fly other the lake is forbiden. Be carful for the landing: neighbours are ticklish. Don\'t land out of the landing area please!

spots.comments: initialy imported from International Leonardo

alti: 926m
the landing is far away, be careful.
This site is close between may 15 and june 15. It\'s close too between august and september.

Landing CLOSED, and so, take off closed !
spots.comments: Landing CLOSED, and so, take off closed !

spots.name: Belvedere
spots.takeoff_description: alti 1401m.

spots.name: Bisanne Nord
spots.takeoff_description: Bisanne Nord
spots.going_there: Same access than the South take off
spots.weather_notes: When a too strong North wind is blowing, or in the afternoon when the Ugine valley breeze dominate South face Thermals, you can launch from there.

spots.name: Bisanne Sud
spots.takeoff_description:
alti: 1940m 
It is near the altitude restaurant. This takeoff is on the top, on the South-East side. Just next to the parking.
spots.going_there:
from 'Albertville', go to 'Les Saisies'. You can stop at the landing area. After go to 'Les Saisies' 
By car : turn to the left when you arrive in this ski station. Keep the road to the end, there is an Altitude restaurant on the top.
During winter or sping when there is still a lot of snow (up to around beginning of May), the road to the takeoff is unusable by car, but you can use the chairlift, there are one way tickets for paragliders.
During summer (July and August) there are (in 2020 : free) buses that you can use from to go from the Valley (Beaufort or Villard sur Doron) to Les Saisies. Then you can use the chairlift (open in July and August) to reach the takeoff

More info somewhere on there site :
https://www.lessaisies.com

In 2020 the information page is here (but it changes every now and then) :
https://www.lessaisies.com/bus-albertville-navettes-intramuros-gratuites.html
spots.weather_notes: Later in the day the breeze might be stronger than the thermals and be coming in your back.
spots.comments:
It might happen that your arrive too late at this takeoff (like 12am or later) and the valley breeze is already blowing from the back (North)
Then there is an alternate takeoff (check the map), that can also be used with North wind from which you can still takeoff and reach the south face (in the lee side).
Discouraged with strong North wind !

A good idee to go to 'Aravis', in spring. Beaufortain is a good district for family holidays: a lots of differents activities.
You can finish your day in 'Le Cormet de Roselend', a soaring site. You will fly until the night with the breeze!

spots.name: breche perier
spots.takeoff_description:
mountain take-off, walk from 'La danchÃƒÂ¨re'(990m) to perier pass (2491m).
hight: 1500m.
spots.comments: a good idee is to walk to the 'col du vallon' (Vallon pass) after this flight, to coming back to venosc by the sky. ;-)
spots.flight_rules:
Don't fly in the end of the Lauvitel valley, it's forbiden.
A convention was signed with the national park, please stop at the House-park to take the map with all the forbiden area.

spots.name: Chalais
spots.takeoff_description:
20 mn by feet from Chalais,
5 km east of Voreppe,
15 km NW from Grenoble.

Easy take off!

Landing not visible from take off.
Take care about thermal wind in valley : morning site !
spots.going_there:
Look at map and directions on site :
http://aec.apinc.org/article.php3?id_article=1
spots.weather_notes: Thermal wind in valley comes quickly with sun : fly there in the morning.

spots.name: Chamoux
spots.takeoff_description:
Small takeoff with nice slope. The take-off is located near the highest point in a valley. So you first have to fly through the valley to get the house-thermal at the beginning of the slope.
Lot's of local schools fly there. Good road to the starting place, last 100 meters by foot.
Toplanding possible.
spots.weather_notes: You have to pay attention to thermic wind at landing, which can be strong in summer (it comes from south).

spots.name: Charande-la moliere
spots.takeoff_description:
alti: 1709m.
from parking walk 30mn on the crest to the south. Takeoff on your left, on the top.
Just for 1 or 2 glides. big grass Slop.
spots.going_there:
from grenoble go to sassenage.
take the D531 road to Lans en Vercors.
Just before Lans take the D106 road on your right, 'Méaudre/Autrans' direction.
On the 'col de la croix Perrin' take a little road to the north (your right), on the hotel back. Follow it until a refuge (Feneys hotel). Take the road on your right and go to the end.
spots.weather_notes: nothing
spots.comments:
unauthorized site.
Only for XC flights: no landing!

spots.name: Charmant Som
spots.takeoff_description: Easy for beginners and tandem
spots.transport_notes: Col de Porte puis marche vers le Charmant Som.
spots.fr_notes: Le Charmant Som, vol montagne en Chartreuse après une marche courte depuis la route du col.

spots.name: chatel-mens

Alti:
big grass area on the top of the 'Chatel' summit. walk 1 h.
from Mens take the D66 road to the north-east. Follow it until 'Cordï¿½ac' and take a track to the south. Stop under the summit and walk to finish.
spots.going_there: Mens is a pretty village between 'La Mure' and 'Clelles', in the south of Isere district.
spots.weather_notes: it's flyable when north wind is too strong to fly on other sites in this district.

spots.takeoff_description: Take-off is prohibited

spots.weather_notes: only with small north wind. If south wind go to 'croix de Belledonne'.
spots.comments: Nice flight, don't wait too late in summer to come here.

spots.name: col de la Bataille

Depuis Léoncel suivre la route du col de la Bataille. Juste avant le tunnel, parking à droite.
Emprunter un sentier qui monte vers la crête sud.
spots.weather_notes: Only without wind, or slight south.
spots.comments:
Site de départ de cross vers les faces sud du Vercors, le Diois, etc.
Site de vol local du matin avec atterrissage à Léoncel.
Site plus généralement du matin... 
En général, aérologie plutôt tonique.

spots.name: Col de la Madeleine
spots.takeoff_description: After Télésiege of Lauzière, at the top (2500m), you can take off from South East (morning), or North East (if valley wind).
spots.going_there: Col de la Madeleine

spots.name: Col de Rousset
spots.takeoff_description: null
spots.weather_notes: Régime de brise - Léger sud
spots.comments: Zone de reproduction des vautours - Respectez les consignes (zonage) voir info sur le site du club

spots.name: Col du Glandon
spots.takeoff_description:
If it\'s breeze or north: on the neck, just near the road. Walk 5 minuts.
If it\'s south wind fly between the \'col du glandon\' and the \'col de la croix de fer\', over the D526 road.
spots.going_there:
2 ways for this site: the north road if you come from \'Chambery\' and the south road if you come from \'Grenoble\'.
From Chambery take the highway to Albertville (A43-E70). Turn to the right, \'Saint Jean de Maurienne\' direction. Go out at \'La Chambre\' and take a little road (D927) to \'Col du Glandon\', south direction. Park your car in the neck.
From Grenoble take the N85 road to \'Vizille\' and \'Bourg d\'Oisans\'. Before this city turn to the left, direction \'Allemont/Vaujany\'. Stay on the  D526 road until a few meters. Turn to the left and park your car.
spots.weather_notes: Be careful about the south wind, sometimes it\'s bad conditions.

spots.name: Col du Sapenay 'Le Belvedere'
spots.takeoff_description: Wooden ramp used by hanggliders, direction west. 897m high.
spots.going_there: From Chindrieux take the D54 to the Sapenay pass
spots.weather_notes: Eastern wind direction is no go. Watch out for strong valley wind caused by Venturi effect with strong north or south winds.
spots.comments: Parking allowed on dedicated parking lot. Do not park on private terrain of 'Le Belvedere'
spots.flight_rules: Maximum flying height is 1200m because of Chambéry airport approach path.

spots.name: col du vallon
spots.takeoff_description: from L'alleau (935m), near Venosc village, take the path to Muselle refuge (2115m). Then go to the Vallon pass (2531m).
spots.flight_rules: A convention was signed with the national park, please stop at the House-park to take the map with all the forbiden area.

spots.name: Colombiers d'Entraigues
spots.takeoff_description:
alti: 1700m
verry sweet and large grass slop.
Good place for waggas. :-D
spots.weather_notes: be carful about strong north wind. You are under the wind (vet montain).
spots.comments: it's the start for the beautiful flights from Philippe Nodet. He turned around the Ecrins national park.

obligation to call local school if you are a group:
Ecole de Parapente AéroSAT 06 70 08 67 59

use the toilets.

spots.name: Fenetre 7

be careful about breeze, strong in the valley .

grass slope just before the summit.

spots.comments: Lorsque les conditions sont "travers droit ou gauche" la sortie du décollage peut être turbulente. Le site étant orienté Ouest, les conditions sont calmes en matinée. Les conditions thermiques s'installent progressivement à partir de 12H et peuvent être parfois fortes en milieu d'après-midi.

spots.name: Montgellafrey

Grass slope, walk a few minutes.
spots.going_there: From Chambery go to Saint Jean de Maurienne. When you are in \'la Chambre\'go on the D213 towards Saint-François Longchamps.  Take a left, before you go up, towards Notre Dame Du Cruet, pass Montgellafrey and continue towards Les Charrieres.  The paved road ends but continue on the gravelroad toward the local lake. Hundred meters passed the lake you can walk up the hill for five minutes before arriving at the take-off.

spots.name: Montgirod-Arcachat
spots.takeoff_description:
2000m
When you are under the power lines along the road after the cheese farm- go to your right on a 4x4 track and make a judgement on where to launch from off the steeper slope

1900m (GPS co-ords)
Normally use this launch on the far SW part of the mountain away from the power lines and easier to access. Go just past the refuge and look for the little wind streamer on the steeper gradient next to some small shrubs, park your car on the corner.
spots.going_there:
From Moutiers take the N90 road, 'Bourg saint Maurice' direction. After the tunnel go into Centron, then up to 'Montgirod' direction.
Go straight up past Montgirod on a little tar farmer road, park by the cheese farm where the tar road ends or go higher if your car can do so. It's about the same distance driving to launch as it is driving up to Forclaz(Annecy) from Doussard, meaning - roughly 15km from Centron to the launch.
spots.weather_notes:
Spring and Autumn : Hunting season, do not go to the toilet in the trees up the mountain.

Summer: Venturi in the valley.

Winter : foehn wind days-you shouldn't be out there anyway.
spots.comments:
XC :
This site starts to work early in the year as well as early in the morning. Facing SE with a very steep gradient that has little cow paddocks and forest getting that morning sun this site boasts some good thermalling opportunities. If the wind is N around to W, it is still possible to get flights in before 1pm thanks to its orientation and the micro climate of the Centon/Villette area. However when the valley system works it comes over the top joining the valley wind from Moutiers towards the high mountains from as early as 11am. BUT-It is possible to fly in the afternoon on a stable day trying to fly bubbles on the lee side especially in Autumn/Winter. 
Despite all meteo winds, every flight at about 10am, there is a light pleasant thermal breeze on launch, with a view of Tignes Grande Motte,Saint Foy,La Rosiere,les Arcs,la Plagne,Val Thorens,Meribel and Courchevel. There are various routes to take once gaining altitude with an early start to your day, some local French pilots have achieved massive distances and return triangles
If you are unlucky with the wind or arrive too late-there is a small ridge to fly from that is a good XC starting point for afternoon flying behind the Montgirod side, the launch faces W called Naves.

ACRO :
Beware : Centron houses and power lines and main road, fly acro over the trees in the left corner.
Fly with a Rogallo or Base system.
Minimum 700m in the box with bad wind, max 1000m starting at 1900m. The same distance driving to launch as driving up to Forclaz(Annecy) from Doussard, but the road is smaller, at least tar all the way up. The glide out to the 'box' can also be compared to Annecy at some (2.5 to 2.7km), this is good because most sites in the French Alps used to do 'acro ploufs' require a long glide that eats height.

the Amieux cliff and the ascending of the Tabuchet glacier all requiring the presence of a mountain guide. Your effort is well rewarded as the refuge is situated in a climbers paradise, at the foot of the Meije summits and in the middle of the glaciers.
duration of climbing: 5h30
vertical: 1800m.

You have to go there hiking or with the chairlift.

I'm unsure but this takeoff might be closed during winter season (because the takeoff is on a ski piste)
The chairlist opens in the end of June, July and August. Rest of the year, you hike (or go elsewhere) !

This takeoff is North oriented, and on top of the ski resort, so North winds or light winds are good for takeoff.
I'm unsure but I guess that beeing protected by the Sambuy summit, West wind might not be too problematic

it seems to have a good restitution.

Read the sign on the takeoff to understand local regulation.

Little field with trees.
on the edge of cliff you can watch the landing area, near the little port.

A sign on the park: \'interdit aux parapentiste\' (forbiden to paraglider). Landing is just in the back of this, in a field but you\'re not authorized to park your car here.

With south wind it\'s flyable, the wind get round chartreuse mountain and comes from SW.
DON\'T FLY HIGHER THAN 320m ABOVE THE TAKEOFF and all along the crest: airplane airway!
